paper_title: Search for Axionlike Dark Matter Using Liquid-State Nuclear Magnetic Resonance
notes: CASPEr-Gradient Low-Field proof-of-principle search using proton NMR on methanol. Constrains ALP gradient-proton coupling g_ap ~ 3e-2 GeV^-1 over mass range 5.576741-5.577733 neV/c2 (Compton freq window 240 Hz at 1.348570 MHz). Note this coupling is quoted in GeV^-1 (dimensionful gradient coupling), not the dimensionless g_ap convention. Limit is 95% CL.
